INSERT INTO voice_user_profiles (user_id, name, updated_at)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
                SET name = EXCLUDED.name,
                    updated_at = GREATEST(voice_user_profiles.updated_at, EXCLUDED.updated_at)
                WHERE voice_user_profiles.updated_at <= EXCLUDED.updated_at
                   OR (voice_user_profiles.name = '' AND voice_user_profiles.active)
